introduction.value: The agent checked Google Calendar for free time and sent an appointment email, but was about 10x slower than manual, the session expired, and the chosen time conflicted.

method.value: The author linked Google Calendar and Gmail as connectors in ChatGPT Agent mode. They asked it to find a free slot this week with a one-hour travel buffer either side, then email the slot to a recipient. The agent said it had no calendar access, so the author reconnected and logged in again, including two-factor on a phone. The agent then checked the calendar and drafted the email, and the author edited it.

outcome.value: The email went out, but the slot it picked already had an appointment in it. The draft included an awkward line about travel buffers that the author had to delete. The whole run was very slow.

notes.value: Expect to log in yourself even with connectors set up. In the author's earlier Shinkansen booking test, agent mode took 20 minutes against 2.5 minutes by hand, and the site session expired.

source_text.body:
Book an appointment using ChatGPT Agent mode
The agent checked Google Calendar for free time and sent an appointment email, but was about 10x slower than manual, the session expired, and the chosen time conflicted.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The author linked Google Calendar and Gmail as connectors in ChatGPT Agent mode. They asked it to find a free slot this week with a one-hour travel buffer either side, then email the slot to a recipient. The agent said it had no calendar access, so the author reconnected and logged in again, including two-factor on a phone. The agent then checked the calendar and drafted the email, and the author edited it.
How it went
The email went out, but the slot it picked already had an appointment in it. The draft included an awkward line about travel buffers that the author had to delete. The whole run was very slow.
Worth knowing
Expect to log in yourself even with connectors set up. In the author's earlier Shinkansen booking test, agent mode took 20 minutes against 2.5 minutes by hand, and the site session expired.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Check my Google Calendar for free time over the next [number] days, then find the booking page or email address for [provider, e.g. my dentist] and propose an appointment that fits [duration] and avoids my existing events. Double-check the chosen slot against my calendar for conflicts. Do not submit the booking form or send any email until you show me the exact time and message and I approve it.
Original source: https://note.com/systemdev/n/n897a42e9deda?hl=en
